reviewerModel: GPT-6 (exact model identifier not exposed to this reviewer)
reviewScope: Read-only source and final-poster critique; no browser, source edits, rebuild, or independent runtime execution. Video comparison uses current Astra transcripts and comparative review evidence, not fresh playback. Acceptance is editorial, not integrated UI QA approval.
rationale: Accept the redesigned mechanism as a modest but meaningful spatial companion, subject to coordinator UI clarity verification. Persistent plunger/selector/pin contact lets the reader inspect why zero failures can mean absent execution. Looking along the bed versus down through its holes serves different causal questions; this is more than a raised route diagram.

findings.issue: The contact table clears the spatial teaching threshold.
findings.evidence: build_scene.py creates twelve actual selector holes above distinct discovered pins, with plunger tips at 1.45, plate top 1.06 and untouched pin tops 0.85. interaction.js holds reach at 0.39 when blocked or 0.75 with pins depressed 0.15 when aligned. Thus the blocked state leaves a 0.21-unit tip-to-pin gap; the aligned state ends in contact at 0.70. An oblique/top view exposes hole alignment, while a low side view exposes whether contact occurred. The evidence stays until another deliberate action. A flat cross-section could explain this, but complementary inspectable surfaces make the spatial affordance meaningful rather than requiring 2D impossibility.

findings.issue: Adds inspection and a controlled counterfactual beyond Evidence first.
findings.evidence: Astra already explains repair, review and no-selection handoff. Here selector changes preserve the current patch, enabling the same patch to produce twelve executed tests or none; toggling after patch 2 review permits the zero-execution comparison on patch 2 too. evaluate() retains the final contact/readout state instead of retracting it or automatically taking another lap.

findings.issue: The smallest causal feature still needs real-size UI confirmation.
findings.evidence: The final poster makes twelve holes, plungers and underlying pins visible and removes the distracting perimeter train. However the plate-to-pin clearance is narrow and warm-on-warm; TESTS RAN and route engravings are small even in the native poster. Only the raised initial head is pictured, so this poster cannot establish settled contact clarity at 420px.
findings.recommendation: Coordinator should inspect held aligned and blocked states at 420px, including a low orbit. Require the contact-versus-gap difference and 0-versus-12 reading to remain distinguishable; enlarge/separate or increase contrast if they do not. This is a visual QA condition, not a request for a new concept.

findings.issue: Faithful within the stated repair-only scope; mechanics are authored illustration.
findings.evidence: The handoff caption says twelve tests exist but none were selected and names the repair-only policy; review explicitly preserves human merge judgment. clearEvidence() precedes patch replacement, so old success is not attached to new code. route is an authored branch over committed selector and patch, not a simulated test engine or collision-derived outcome. Busy locking and selector commitment address the prior race in static source inspection. Budgets and diagnostic automation remain outside this specimen.

limitations: GLB bytes were hashed; Blender build source was inspected, but scene.blend and GLB geometry were not independently loaded.
Author-reported headless harness results were read, not rerun. No browser or alternate-state renders were generated.
